# Karetao shared SPI golden frames. Format and rules: README.md in this directory.
# This file is the authority; make_vectors.py regenerates it and `--check` compares.
# Hex values are byte sequences in wire order: the first two characters are byte 0.
# Bytes beyond a request or response up to the 512-byte transaction are zero.

[boot_status]
description = First frame after boot (SPI_SYSTEM_INTERFACE.md section 4): DIAGNOSTIC (0x03) with an empty payload as built; ruling R14 adds the DIAGNOSTIC v1 content.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 1
stm32.last_request_seq = none
stm32.now_us = 1000
expect = OK
response = 5AA50103000001000000E803000000000000EAA05CC4
response.type = 0x03
response.seq = 1
response.frame_time_us = 1000
response.payload = 

[get_status_ack]
description = GET_STATUS with the four-byte request payload (schema 1, three reserved zero bytes); answered by ACK with status 0 and the request seq echoed.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 2
stm32.last_request_seq = none
stm32.now_us = 2000
request = 5AA5011104000A000000000000000000000001000000E382BB92
request.type = 0x11
request.seq = 10
request.frame_time_us = 0
request.payload = 01000000
expect = OK
response = 5AA501800C0002000000D007000000000000011100000A000000000000001CA79C8F
response.type = 0x80
response.seq = 2
response.frame_time_us = 2000
response.payload = 011100000A00000000000000

[get_snapshot_staged]
description = GET_SNAPSHOT while a snapshot is staged: the staged payload is sent as SNAPSHOT with response_to_seq patched to the request seq (six sensor records, one motor record).
stm32.next_tx_seq = 3
stm32.last_request_seq = 10
stm32.now_us = 3000
stm32.staged_snapshot = 
request = 5AA5011004000B0000000000000000000000010000002A9331EB
request.type = 0x10
request.seq = 11
request.frame_time_us = 0
request.payload = 01000000
expect = OK
response = 
response.type = 0x01
response.seq = 3
response.frame_time_us = 3000
response.payload = 

[get_snapshot_none_staged]
description = GET_SNAPSHOT with nothing staged is acknowledged, not answered with a SNAPSHOT.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 4
stm32.last_request_seq = 11
stm32.now_us = 4000
request = 5AA5011004000C0000000000000000000000010000005F6BC816
request.type = 0x10
request.seq = 12
request.frame_time_us = 0
request.payload = 01000000
expect = OK
response = 5AA501800C0004000000A00F000000000000011000000C00000000000000B66523FE
response.type = 0x80
response.seq = 4
response.frame_time_us = 4000
response.payload = 011000000C00000000000000

[get_version]
description = GET_VERSION answered by VERSION (0x04). The identity fields (version, build flags, git hash, commit epoch) are the host-test fallback identity of firmware_version.h, not contract; the layout, type and response_to_seq are.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 5
stm32.last_request_seq = 12
stm32.now_us = 5000
request = 5AA5011404000D0000000000000000000000010000002CF7C851
request.type = 0x14
request.seq = 13
request.frame_time_us = 0
request.payload = 01000000
expect = OK
response = 5AA50104140005000000881300000000000001010001000000000D00000000000000000000008BEDF1D7
response.type = 0x04
response.seq = 5
response.frame_time_us = 5000
response.payload = 01010001000000000D0000000000000000000000

[time_sync_ack]
description = TIME_SYNC (deprecated by Issue #12, still implemented) with its 16-byte payload: the protocol module ACKs a well-formed request. The service may still NACK BAD_TIME_SYNC after time_service judges the sample; that path is not a frame-format fact.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 6
stm32.last_request_seq = 13
stm32.now_us = 6000
request = 5AA5011210000E00000000000000000000000100000000401E18240A060007000000E15C4307
request.type = 0x12
request.seq = 14
request.frame_time_us = 0
request.payload = 0100000000401E18240A060007000000
expect = OK
response = 5AA501800C00060000007017000000000000011200000E00000000000000957A7D99
response.type = 0x80
response.seq = 6
response.frame_time_us = 6000
response.payload = 011200000E00000000000000

[nack_bad_magic]
description = Magic 0xA55B instead of 0xA55A (CRC valid over the bytes as sent): NACK BAD_MAGIC.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 7
stm32.last_request_seq = 14
stm32.now_us = 7000
request = 5BA5011104000F000000000000000000000001000000353BCAFF
expect = BAD_MAGIC
response = 5AA501810C0007000000581B000000000000011101000F000000000000008C9FB0AB
response.type = 0x81
response.seq = 7
response.frame_time_us = 7000
response.payload = 011101000F00000000000000

[nack_bad_version]
description = protocol_version 2 (CRC valid): NACK BAD_VERSION.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 8
stm32.last_request_seq = 15
stm32.now_us = 8000
request = 5AA502110400100000000000000000000000010000009B4B862F
expect = BAD_VERSION
response = 5AA501810C0008000000401F000000000000011102001000000000000000B47C7C92
response.type = 0x81
response.seq = 8
response.frame_time_us = 8000
response.payload = 011102001000000000000000

[nack_bad_length]
description = payload_len 491, one above the 490-byte maximum; the frame has no CRC position inside 512 bytes, so the request is the full 512-byte transaction: NACK BAD_LENGTH.
stm32.next_tx_seq = 9
stm32.last_request_seq = 16
stm32.now_us = 9000
request = 
expect = BAD_LENGTH
response = 5AA501810C00090000002823000000000000011103001100000000000000E509E157
response.type = 0x81
response.seq = 9
response.frame_time_us = 9000
response.payload = 011103001100000000000000

[nack_bad_crc]

stm32.next_tx_seq = 10
stm32.last_request_seq = 17
stm32.now_us = 10000
request = 5AA50111040012000000000000000000000001000000CDDC70F8

response.type = 0x81
response.seq = 10
response.frame_time_us = 10000
response.payload = 011104001200000000000000

[nack_bad_sequence]
description = A well-formed GET_STATUS whose seq equals the last accepted request seq is not newer (SPI_SYSTEM_INTERFACE.md section 6): NACK BAD_SEQUENCE.

stm32.last_request_seq = 18
stm32.now_us = 11000

response.type = 0x81
response.seq = 11
response.frame_time_us = 11000
response.payload = 011105001200000000000000

[nack_bad_message]
description = Unassigned message type 0x15 (CRC valid): NACK BAD_MESSAGE. Not a transport-valid frame for the Pi decoder either, so no request fields.

stm32.last_request_seq = 18
stm32.now_us = 12000

response.type = 0x81
response.seq = 12
response.frame_time_us = 12000
response.payload = 011506001300000000000000
